newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - Aug 15.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - Aug 15.

text.p: The following stories appeared in Friday's Daily Variety:

* "Home Improvement" star Tim Allen, sources say, is still "wrestling" with the decision of whether to sign on for an eighth year of the hit ABC/Disney sitcom which begins its seventh season Sept. 23.
* ABC has laid off about 100 employees and eliminated another 100 or so positions that were vacant.
* Dow Jones' The Wall Street Journal unit will shortly begin publication of both a daily listing of television programs and a weekly listing of Broadway shows.
* Microsoft is pulling the plug on its Cinemania film-related web site, firing more than half its staff.
* This fall, there will be a record 10 hours in primetime magazines.
